description:
Compute a person's Vedic birth star (janma nakshatra and pada), Moon sign and — when the birth time is known —
    ascendant (lagna), from their birth details. Sidereal (Lahiri), computed
    from the birth moment.

    birth_date: YYYY-MM-DD. birth_place: city and country, e.g. "Pune, India". birth_time: HH:MM, 24-hour, local time
    at the birth place — omit if unknown (the ascendant then can't be given, and the Moon may be one of two signs or
    stars that day). The details are used for this answer only and never stored.
name: find_birth_star
title: Find a birth star
